notes: Real bug (mechanism re-read from the actual diff, not the commit subject): the pre-fix condition in MapAdapter.build() was `not force_external and (subdomain_matching or host_matching) and ((subdomain_matching and domain_part == self.subdomain) or (host_matching and host == self.server_name))` -- a three-term AND-chain with no branch for 'neither subdomain nor host matching is configured', so a rule with no host/subdomain scoping stopped matching. The fix rewrote it to `not force_external and (not (subdomain_matching or host_matching) or (subdomain_matching and domain_part == self.subdomain) or (host_matching and host == self.server_name))`, adding the missing OR-branch. NOTE: the commit subject reads 'fix boolean logic for external url', which invited an earlier reconstruction attempt to model this as a simple inverted flag; it is not -- it is a missing-OR-branch/De Morgan-shaped compound-condition bug, and that first attempt was rejected in adjudication for exactly that reason. Fixed alongside two dedicated routing tests. Small, single-mechanism diff (21 lines, one source file + one test file) -- exactly the shape this queue wants: isolable, not entangled with unrelated changes. Recommend 'transformed': rebuild a minimal routing-like predicate carrying the same missing-OR-branch compound-condition defect rather than copying werkzeug's actual routing internals verbatim. Category fit: logic-error (missing branch in a compound condition) -- a well-represented category in v2 but this instance is 'real', giving a same-category real-vs-synthetic comparison point once admitted.
